title: host.renew body
description: A host renews its certificate and connection credential, or rotates its keys.

contract_sha256.description: The host's contract digest; while the label is a pre-release, the authority answers protocol_mismatch when it differs from its own.

new_nats_public_key.description: A new NATS user key for the credential of the reply. Required when the renewal gives up a partition (a released partition ownership record names the host) or a pool (the profile drops one): the authority refuses such a renewal without it (invalid_body at /body/new_nats_public_key), and the old key is revoked.

partitions.description: The partitions of the host's one team that the reply's credential is to name, for a lead or worker host: each must have a partition ownership record owned by this host. The authority issues exactly these, never a partition a released record names, so a partition the host is not ready to take up, or one that would not fit, never blocks its other renewals; a credential that does not fit is refused as not_allowed, and the host renews again without the new ones. Absent means none: the team services, which read every partition of their team, and the other roles own none (README, "Credentials follow ownership").

application_key_rotation.description: Both the new application key and its proof are required when rotating. The proof signs the renewal frame as specified in README.md, using the new private key.
